kultivator.technique.shadow_devil_fusion: Your shadow detaches and scouts. You turn invisible for 400→600 ticks; every monster within 32 blocks (up to 32) loses track of you, takes ×2 from your next hit and is highlighted for you alone for 400 ticks.
Source: Tales of Demons and Gods ch. 40–56 · Nie Li's Shadow Devil demon spirit, a trace-concealing scout; fusing with it needs Silver rank
The shadow at your feet opens one violet eye, then is gone.
kultivator.technique.samadhi_wind.desc: Channel 3 seconds of yellow sand-wind: a 14→24-block cone deals 0.3×P every half second, blinds for 120 ticks, slows (Slowness II, 60 ticks) and pushes monsters back.
kultivator.technique.samadhi_wind.source: Source: Journey to the West ch. 21 · 三昧神风 Samadhi Divine Wind of the Yellow Wind Great King, which blinds Sun Wukong until Lingji Bodhisattva subdues him
kultivator.technique.samadhi_wind.lore: Even fiery golden eyes water in this wind.
kultivator.technique.star_god_broken_sha: Stage 1: blink from monster to monster 5→10 times within 20 blocks, striking each for 1.8×P; every afterimage bursts for 0.6×P. Stage 2 (within 2 s): blink back to where you started.
Source: Against the Gods · 星神碎影 Star God's Broken Shadow, the Star God Realm's movement divine art used by Jasmine, which splits the user into afterimages
Starlight shatters, and every shard is you.
A swarm of silver butterflies covers up to 8→20 monsters within 24 blocks with soul damage of 0.35×P per second for 10 s; twelve of them circle you for 10 s and swallow up to 12 incoming projectiles.
Source: Heaven Official's Blessing · Hua Cheng's silver wraith butterflies (死灵蝶), heralds of his presence that swarm his enemies
Where the silver wings gather, a certain ghost king is never far.
kultivator.technique.banana_leaf_fan.des: Stage 1: one swing sends a wall of wind 32→64 blocks long and 8→24 wide: 2.2×P and a huge knockback. Stage 2 (within 3 s): the back-swing pulls monsters in a 24-block cone toward you for 1×P.
kultivator.technique.banana_leaf_fan.sou: Source: Journey to the West ch. 59–61 · Princess Iron Fan's banana-leaf fan blows Sun Wukong tens of thousands of li away; Lingji's Wind-Settling Pill lets him withstand it
kultivator.technique.banana_leaf_fan.lor: One fan of the leaf, and the enemy is somewhere past the horizon.
kultivator.technique.wind_roaring_format: Raises a cyclone formation of radius 14→28 at the aimed spot for 15 s: 0.3×P and fire every half second; every 2 s monsters are spun, lifted and blinded. When it ends, ten thousand blades strike everything inside for 3×P.
Source: Investiture of the Gods ch. 44/46 · 風吼陣 of Dong Tianjun, one of the Ten Absolute Formations: wind and fire with ten thousand blades; Cihang breaks it with the Wind-Fixing Pearl
The four banners wave once, and the wind starts carrying knives.
kultivator.technique.soul_falling_format: A white-banner formation of radius 16→28 for 12 s: every 2 s, soul damage of 0.5×P per second for 4 s and a 25% chance to stun for 30 ticks. When it ends, every monster inside below 15% health (bosses 5%) is executed.
Source: Investiture of the Gods ch. 44/48 · 落魂陣 of Yao Bin (姚斌): a white paper banner with talisman seals, "白旛展动，魄消魂散", plus a straw-figure soul ritual
The paper banner stirs, and souls forget the way back to their bodies.
kultivator.technique.billion_soul_flag.d: Plants a soul flag with a field of radius 20→32 for 20 s: 0.5×P armour-piercing damage every second; each kill feeds it (+3%, up to 50 stacks). When it ends, the souls burst for 4×P plus 0.15×P per stack.
kultivator.technique.billion_soul_flag.s: Source: Renegade Immortal · the Soul Refining Sect's billion-soul flag, with the souls of 12 Soul Transformation ancestors sealed inside
kultivator.technique.billion_soul_flag.l: Every scream on the wind is one more soul for the flag.
Forbidden: costs 10% of your current health (never below 1). Raises 8 fierce corpses for 25 s that attack every second for 1.5×P; every 5 s a wave of terror weakens and slows monsters within 24 blocks.
Source: Mo Dao Zu Shi · 阴虎符 Stygian Tiger Seal, which Wei Wuxian forges from the iron sword in the Tortoise of Carnage's cave and uses to command fierce corpses with his flute Chenqing
A flute note in the dark, and the dead answer it.
kultivator.technique.kunpeng_art.desc: After a 1 s charge, a Kun wind crescent travels 128 blocks through everything (12→24 wide): 16×P and knockback, while you dash 32 blocks behind it. Where it ends, a ring wave of 8→24 deals 6×P.
kultivator.technique.kunpeng_art.source: Source: Perfect World ch. 347 on · Shi Hao's Kun Peng precious technique (鲲鹏宝术); the 128-block wind crescent is game design
kultivator.technique.kunpeng_art.lore: In the northern darkness there is a fish; when it rises, the sky is cut in two.
kultivator.technique.karma_domain.desc: Disciples only (star 46). A domain of radius 16→32 for 20 s links every monster inside: damage to one passes 40% to the others (bosses 25%). The master, disciples and pets inside reflect monster hits back.
kultivator.technique.karma_domain.source: Source: Renegade Immortal · Wang Lin's Karma domain
kultivator.technique.karma_domain.lore: Every blow returns along the red thread it came from.
